Game Overview

Multiverse Space War puts players into a shooter experience centered on embark on an interstellar adventure as James, a heroic pilot battling multiversal invaders. Master strategic maneuvers and swift reflexes to navigate deadly meteor storms and enemy fleets. With immersive high-stakes aerial combat, your mission is to defend and save the universe from renegade spaceships.
